name: KY-050 ultrasonic distance sensor
not_buildable: It only works with 5 volts and needs a trigger output pin; the vendor warns that it can damage a lower-voltage board without a level shifter.
identification: Blue PCB with two large silver cylinders with mesh fronts side by side, like a pair of eyes, and 4 header pins labelled Vcc, Trig, Echo, GND.

facts.statement: The sensor measures 2 cm to 300 cm. It works only at the 5 V level; the vendor connects it to 3.3 V boards through the KY-051 level shifter and warns of permanent damage otherwise.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-050, technical data and Raspberry Pi notes
